name: Nicaragua
famous_for: Volcano boarding down black cinder slopes of Cerro Negro, colonial pastel Granada on Lake Nicaragua, and Ometepe twin-volcano island.
tourists: Over 1.2M visitors; highlights include Granada cobblestones, Masaya glowing lava lake, and surf breaks in San Juan del Sur.
must_know: Lake Nicaragua is the largest freshwater lake in Central America and is uniquely home to oceanic bull sharks that swim upriver.
fun_fact: Cerro Negro is the only place in the world where thrill-seekers hike up an active volcano and sandboard down loose black ash at 80 km/h.
